# E0144: a lens refers to a schema of the lineage

A lens returns a field of a schema, read through the lineage. A lens may
refer only to the instance it takes, its own body and CUE's builtin packages
(reference rule ref-lens-to-schema); it builds what it returns from the
instance it takes.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
lin: {
	name: "ship"
	schemas: {
		"0": "0": {
			schema: {a: string}
		}
		"1": "0": {
			schema: {b: string}
		}
	}
	lenses: {
		"1.0->0.0": {
			v1_0: _
			v0_0: {a: v1_0.b}
		}
		"0.0->1.0": {
			v0_0: _
			v1_0: {b: lin.schemas["0"]["0"].schema.a}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0144]: v1_0.b in lens 0.0->1.0 refers to schemas["0"]["0"].schema.a, a schema
  --> lineage.cue:18:14
   |
18 |             v1_0: {b: lin.schemas["0"]["0"].schema.a}
   |                       ^^^
   |
   = note: reference rule ref-lens-to-schema
   = help: a lens may refer only to v0_0, the instance it takes, its own body and CUE's builtin packages
```
